## Type values

`bug`, `gap`, `contradiction`, `drift`, `question`, `risk`, `opportunity`

## Severity values

`critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`

## Status values

`open`, `in progress`, `deferred`, `resolved`, `wontfix`, `duplicate`

## Adding one

1. Copy `docs/findings/_template.md` to a new file named after its ID.
2. Fill every field; run `python -m kernel.docs_plane --write` (or `make docs`) to regenerate this index.
3. Commit the file and the index together; `scripts/verify.sh` refuses a file without its row.
